1. शुभ् (or 1. शुम्भ्) cl. 1. Ā. or cl. 6. P. (Dhātup. xviii, 11; xxviii, 33) शोभते, शुम्भति or शुम्भति (ep. also शोभति, and Ved. शुम्भते; 3. sg. शोभे, RV.; pf. शुशोभ, शुशुभे, MBh. &c.; शुशुम्भ Gr.; aor., अशुभत्, अशोभिष्ट, अशुम्भीत्, ib.; p. शुम्भान, शुभान, RV.; fut. शोभिता or शुम्भिता Gr.; शोभिष्यति, MBh.; शुम्भिष्यति Gr.; inf. शुभे, शोभासे, RV.; शोभितुम् Gr.), to beautify, embellish, adorn, beautify one's self. (Ā.) look beautiful or handsome, shine, be bright or splendid; (with इव or यथा, ‘to shine or look like’; with न, ‘to look bad, have a bad appearance, appear to disadvantage’), RV. &c. &c.; to prepare, make fit or ready, (Ā.) prepare one's self, RV.; AV.; (शुम्भते accord. to some) to flash or flit i.e. glide rapidly past or along, RV. (cf. शुभान, शुम्भमान, and प्र-√ शुम्भ्); (शुम्भति) wrongly for शुन्धति (to be connected with √ शुध्, to purify), AV. vi, 155, 3; xii, 2, 40 &c.; (शुम्भति) to harm, injure, Dhātup. xi, 42 (in this sense rather to be regarded as a second √ शुम्भ् cf. √ 2. शुम्भ्, नि-शुम्भ्) : Pass. aor. अशोभि-तराम्, Inscr. : Caus. शोभयति (aor. अशूशुभत् ; cf. शोभित), to cause to shine, beautify, ornament, decorate, AV. &c. &c.; (शुभयति, ˚ते) to ornament, decorate, (Ā.) decorate one's self, RV.; TBr.; (only pr. p. शुभयत्), to fly rapidly along, RV. : Desid. शुशोभिषते (accord. to Gr. also ˚ति, and शुशुभिषति, ˚ते), to wish to prepare or make ready, Nir. viii, 10 : Intens. शोशुभ्यते (Gr. also शोशोब्धि), to shine brightly or intensely, be very splendid or beautiful, MBh.
2. शुभ् f. (dat. शुभे as inf.) splendour, beauty, ornament, decoration, RV.; AV.; VS.; TBr.
flashing or flitting past, gliding along, rapid course or flight, RV.; AV.; TS.
readiness (?), RV.
a: शुभ् — {c1c} A. शोभते 1 To shine, be splendid, look beautiful or handsome; सुष्ठु शोभसे एतेन विनयमाहात्म्येन U. 1; R. 8. 6. --2 To appear to advantage; सुखं हि दुःखान्यनुभूय शोभते Mk. 1. 10. --3 To suit, become, befit (with gen.); रामभद्र इत्येवोपचारः शोभते तातपरिजनस्य U. 1. --4 To be gay or happy. --5 To be victorious. --Caus. (शोभयनि-ते) To decorate, adorn, grace. --WITH परि, -वि to shine, look splendid.

(Dhātup. iii, 37) शुन्धति, ˚ते (Impv. शुन्द्धि, ĀśvGṛ.; pf. शुशुन्ध aor. अशुन्धीत् fut. शुन्धिता, शुन्धिष्यति Gr.), to purify (Ā. ‘one's self’, become or be pure), RV.; VS.; TBr.; GṛŚrS.; cl. 4. P. Ā. (Dhātup. xxvi, 82) शुध्यति (mc. also ˚ते; pf. शुशोध, aor. अशुधत्, fut. शोद्धा, शोत्स्यति, inf. शोद्धुम् Gr.), to be cleared or cleansed or purified, become pure (esp. in a ceremonial sense), VS.; Mn.; MBh. &c.; to become clear or free from doubts, R.; Mṛcch.; to be cleared or excused from blame, to be excusable, Kathās. : Pass. शुध्यते (aor. अशोधि) Gr.: Caus. शुन्धयति, to clear, purify, VS.; शोधयति (aor. अशूशुधत्), to purify (esp. in a ceremonial sense), TS. &c. &c.; to correct, improve, Yājñ., Sch.; to remove (impurity or anything noxious), Mn.; MBh. &c.; to clear off, pay (debts), Rājat.; Kull.; to acquit, exculpate, justify, Mn.; Kām.; to put to test, Kathās.; to try, examine, Pañcat.; Yājñ., Sch.; to make clear, explain, Vedāntas.; Madhus.; to subtract, Gaṇit. : Desid. शुशुत्सति, Nidānas. : Intens. शोशुध्यते, शोशोद्धि Gr.
a: शुध् — {c4c} P. (शुध्यति, शुद्ध) 1 To become pure or purified; (fig. also); मृतोयैः शुध्यते शोध्यं नदी वेगेन शुध्यति . अद्भिर्गात्राणि शुध्यंति मनः सत्येन शुध्यति Ms. 5. 108-9. --2 To be auspicious, favourable, or eligible; तिथिरेव तावन्न शुध्यति Mu. 5. --3 To be made clear, have the doubts removed; न शुध्यति मेंऽतरात्मा Mk. 8. --4 To be defrayed or cleared; व्ययः शुध्यति Pt. 5. --Caus. (शोधयति-ते) 1 To purify, cleanse, wash off. --2 To clear, pay off (as a debt). --3 To refine, filter. --4 To correct. --5 To acquit. --6 To examine, investigate, inquire into. --WITH परि, --वि, सं to be purified; R. 12. 104; Ms. 5. 64.

a: शुद्ध — p. p. [शुध्-क्त] 1 Pure, clean, purified; अंतःशुद्धस्त्वमपि भविता वर्णमात्रेण कृष्णः Me. 49. --2 Holy, undefiled, chaste, innocent; अन्वमीयत शुद्धोति शांतेन वपुषैव सा R. 15. 77, 14. 14, --3 White, bright. --4 Stainless, spotless. --5 Innocent, simple, guileless. --6 (a) Genuine, true. (b) Honest, upright. --7 Correct, faultless, upright. --8 Cleared, acquitted. --9 Mere, only. --10 Simple, pure, unmixed; (opp. मिश्र). --11 Unequalled. --12 Authorized. --13 Whetted, sharpened. --14 Not nasal. --द्धः An epithet of Śiva. --द्धं 1 Anything pure. --2 The pure spirit. --3 Rock-salt. --4 Black pepper. --Comp. --अंतः a king's female apartments, harem, seraglio; शुद्धांतदुर्लभमिदं वपुराश्रमवासिनो यदि जनस्य Ś. 1. 17; Ku. 6. 52. {2} a king's wife. ˚चारिन् m. an attendant in the harem, a chamberlain; U. 1. ˚पालकः, --˚रक्षकः a guard of the harem. --अंता a king's wife, queen. --अपह्नुतिः f. a figure of speech; it is thus defined: --शुधापह्नुतिरन्यस्यारोपार्थो धर्मनिह्नवः. --आत्मन् a. pure-minded, honest. (--m.) {1} the pure spirit. {2} N. of Śiva. --ओदनः (शुद्धोदनः) N. of the father of the celebrated Buddha. ˚सुतः N. of the celebrated Buddha. --कर्मन् a. pure in deeds, holy. --कोटिः f. one of the sides of a right-angled triangle. --चैतन्यं pure intelligence. --जंघः an ass. --धी, --भाव, --मति a. pure-minded, guileless, honest. --वधः killing in a simple or ordinary way. --वंश्य a. born of a pure family; R. 1. 69.

शुद्ध—वासस् mfn. dressed in clean garments, W.
शुद्ध—वंश्य mf(आ)n. of a pure family or race, Ragh.

v: strI karma॰ । 1 guqUcyAM Sabdaca॰ 2 pavitrAyAM latAyAYca Sabdaca॰ ।

s: strI, (SudDA vallikA latA .) guqUcO iti SabdacandrikA ॥ pavitralatA ca ॥
m: शुद्ध—वल्लिका f. a kind of plant (Cocculus Cordifolius or Menispermum Glabrum), L.
शुद्ध—वर्ण mfn. having a pure colour or caste, being of high caste &c., W.
well lettered, having clear words, perspicuous (as a speech), MW.
शुद्ध—वत् mfn. containing the word शुद्ध
शुद्ध—वती (अती), f. N. of the verses, RV. viii, 95, 7-9; Baudh.; Vas.
शुद्ध—वेष mfn. = -वासस्, Ragh.
शुद्ध—विराज् f.
शुद्ध—विराड्-ऋषभ n. N. of metres, Col.
शुद्ध—विष्कम्भक m. (in dram.) a pure interlude (in which only speakers of Sanskṛt take part, such as that between the second and third act of the Śakuntalā; opp. to संकीर्ण-व्˚, q.v.), Bhar.
शुद्ध—षड्जा f. (in music) a partic. Mūrchanā, Saṃgīt.

s: strI, (SuTa + ktin .) durgA । yaTA, -- “smaraRAccintanAdvApi SoDyate sa hi pAtakAt tena Su dDiH samAKyAtA devI rudratanO sTitA ॥” iti devIpurARe devIniruktADyAyaH 45 ॥ mArjjanA । iti jawADaraH ॥ vEdikakarmmArhatvaprayojakasaMskAraviSezaH । yaTA । SudDyaSudDyoH saMskArarUpatvena ekapuruzasyEkadoBayasTitirGawate aSu dDerBAvarUpatve SudDe stadaBAvarUpatve nEtat viroDAt । ataeva SaNKaH । “tataH SrAdDamaSu dDO tu kuryyAdekAdaSe taTA । karttustAtkAlikI SudDiraSudDaH punareva saH ॥” aSudDO caturTAhAdO । kaTamaSudDO SrAdDaM kAlASOcasyADikAriviSezaRatvAdata AhakarttustAtkAlikIti । SrAdDaviDAnAkzepAttanmAtranizWA SudDiH kalpyate । sa punaraSudDa eva karmmAntara eva । iti SrAdDavivekaH ॥ evaM SudDerBAvarUpatve aSOcasya tadaBAvarUpatve viroDaH । taTAtve aSOcasaNkaro'pi na syAt । ekasmin Su dDyaBAvarUpe aSOce satyaparasya tadrUpasya tadAnIM tatpuruzIyaSu dDirUpapratiyogyantarABAvAdanutpatteH । tasmAt SudDyaSu dDyorBAvarUpatvam । iti SudDitatvam ॥ * ॥ aTASOciSudDiH । “aGavfdDimadASOcamUrdDvaYcettena SuDyati । aTa cet paYcamIM rAtrimatItya parato Bavet । aGavfdDimadASOcaM tadA pUrvveRa SuDyati ॥” aGavfdDimattantu । sapiRqajananASOcApekzayA svaputtrajananASOcasya sapiRqamaraRASOcApekzayA pitfmAtfmartfmaraRASOcasya । * । “jAte puttre pituH snAnaM sacelantu viDIyate । mAtA SuDyeddaSAhena snAnAttu sparSanaM pituH ॥” SuDyet sparSamAtre uttaravAkye taTA darSanAt । * । jananASOcamaDye tu yadyaparaM jananaM syAt tadA pUrvvASOcavyapagame SudDiH rAtriSeze dinadvayena praBAte dinatrayeRa maraRASOcamaDye jYAtimaraRe 'pyevamiti ॥ * ॥ “yasya yasya tu varRasya yadyat syAt paScimaM tvahaH । sa tatra vastraSu dDiYca gfhaSudDiM karotyapi ॥ samApya daSamaM piRqaM yaTASAstramudAhftam । grAmAdbahistato gatvA pretaspfzwe ca vAsasI ॥ antyAnAmASritAnAYca tyaktvA snAnaM karotyapi । SmaSrulomanaKAnAYca yattyAjyaM tajjahAtyapi ॥ gOrasarzapakalkena tilatElena saMyutaH । SiraH snAnaM tataH kftvA toyenAcamya vAgyataH ॥ vAsoyugaM navaM Su BramavraRaM SudDameva ca । gfhItvA gAM suvarRaYca maNgalAni SuBAni ca ॥ spfzwvA saMkIrttayitvA tu paScAt SudDo BavennaraH ॥” gfhaSudDiH prAktanapAkaBARqaparityAga upalepAdinA । tyAjyaM tyAgArham । “aGAhaHsu nivfttezu susnAtAH kftamaNgalAH । ASucyAdvipramucyeta brAhmaRAn svastivAcya ca svalpASOcasya maDye tu dIrGASOcaM Bavedyadi । na tu pUrvveRa SudDiH syAt svakAlenEva SuDyati mamAnaM laGu cASOcaM pUrvveREva viSu Dyati । yadi syAt sUtake sUtirmf take ca mftirBavet ॥ SezeREva BavecCudDirahaHSeze dvirAtrakam । maraRotpattiyoge tu maraRAcCudDirizyate ॥ * ॥ arvvAk zaRmAsataH strIRAM yadi syAt garBasaMsravaH । tadA mAsasamEstAsAM divasEH SudDirizyite ॥ garBaSrutyAM yaTAmAsamacire tUttame tryahaH । rAjanye tu catUrAtraM vESye paYcAhameva ca ॥ azwAhena tu SUdrasya SudDirezA prakIrttitA । rAtriBirmAsatulyABirgarBasrAve viSuDyati ॥ rajasyuparate sADvI snAnena strI rajasvalA । SudDA BarttuScaturTe'hni aSudDA dEvapEtrayoH । dEve karmmaRi pEtrye ca paYcame'hani SuDyati ॥ * ॥ dattA nArI piturgehe sUyate mriyate'TavA । svamaSOcaM caret samyak pfTaksTAnavyavasTitA ॥ tadbanDuvargastvekena SuDyettu janakastriBiH । yastEH sahAsanaM kuryyAt SayanAdIni cEva hi । bAnDavo vA paro vApi sa daSAhena SuDyati ॥ strIRAmasaMskftAnAntu tryahAt SuDyanti bAnDavAH । yaToktenEva kalpena SuDyanti hi sanABayaH ॥ * ॥ zaRmAsAByantare SUdre mfte bAle tryahaM viduH । anatIte dvivarze vE mfte SuDyettu paYcaBiH ॥ bAlastvantardaSAhe tu pretatvaM yadi gacCati । sadya eva viSudDiH syAnnASOcaM nEva sUtakam ॥ nfRAmakftacUqAnAmaSudDirnESikI smftA । nivftacUqakAnAntu trirAtrAcCudDirizyate ॥ * ॥ daSAhena sapiRqAstu SuDyanti pretasUtake । trirAtreRa sakuKyAstu snAtvA SuDyanti gotrajAH ॥ SuDye dvipro daSAhena dvAdaSAhena BUmipaH । vESyaH paYcadaSAhena SUdro mAsena SuDyati ॥ daSame'hani SUdrasya kAryyaM saMsparSanaM buDEH । mAsenEva viSudDiH syAt sUtake mftake'pi vA ॥ saMsTite pakziRIM rAtriM dOhitre BaginIsute । saMskfte tu trirAtraM syAditi Darmmo vyavasTitaH ॥ pitroruparame strIRAmUQAnAntu kaTaM Bavet । trirAtreREva SudDiH syAdityAha BagavAn SivaH ॥ yadA BojanakAle tu aSucirBavati dvijaH । BUmO niHkzipya tadgrAsaM snAtvA cEva viSuDyati ॥ * ॥ cikitsakO yat kurute tadanyena na Sakyate । tasmAt cikitsakasparSe SudDo Bavati nityaSaH ॥ garBiRI sUtikA naktaM kumArI ca rajasvalA । yadASudDA tadAnyena kArayet kriyate sadA ॥ * ॥ pretIBUtaM dvijaM vipro yo'nugacCati kAmataH । snAtvA sacelaM spfzwvAgniM GftaM prASya viSuDyati । ekAhAt kzattriye SudDirvESye ca syAddvyahena tu । SUdre dinatrayaM proktaM prARAyAmaSataM punaH ॥ * ॥ nAraM spfzwvAsTi sasnehaM snAtvA vipro viSuDyati । AcamyEva tu nisnehaM gAmAlaByArkamIkzya vA ॥ asapiRqaM dvijaM pretaM vipro nirhftya banDuvat । viSuDyati trirAtreRa mAturAptAMSca bAnDavAn ॥ yadyannamatti tezAntu sa daSAhena SuDyati । anadannannamahnEva na cettasmin gfhe vaset ॥ * ॥ asTisaYcayanAdarvvAk yadi vipro'Sru pAtayet । mfte SUdre gfhaM gatvA trirAtreRa viSuDyati ॥ asTisaYcayanAdUrdDaM yAvanmAsaM dvijAtayaH । divasenEva SudDiH syAdvAsasAM kzAlanena ca ॥ * ॥ svajAterdivasenEva tryahAt kzatriyavESyayoH । sparSaM vinAnugamane SUdro naktena SuDyati ॥ * ॥ ajA gAvo mahizyaSca brAhmaRI ca prasUtikA । daSarAtreRa SuDyanti BUmizWaYca navodakam ॥ * ॥ udakyA sUtikA vApi antyajaM saMspfSedyadi । trirAtreREva SudDiH syAditi SAtAtapo'bravIt ॥ * navaKAtajalaM gAvo mahizyaSCAgayonayaH । Su Dyanti divasEreva daSaBirnAtra saMSayaH ॥ kAle navodakaM SudDaM na pAtavyantu tattryaham ॥” * ॥ aTa dravyaSudDiH । brAhme । “suvarRarUpyaSaNKASmaSu ktiratnamayAni ca । kAMsAyastAmrarEtyAni trapusIsamayAni ca ॥ nirlepAni viSu Dyanti kevalena jalena tu । SudrocCizwAni SuDyanti triDAkzArAmlavAriBiH ॥ sUtikASavaviRmUtrarajasvalAhatAni ca । prakzeptavyAni tAnagnO yacca yAvat sahedapi ॥” rEtyaM pittalam । trapu raNgam । yatpAtraM yAvat । kAlamagniM saheta tat pAtraM prakzAlanAntaraM । tAvattApanIyamityarTaH ॥ * ॥ bfhaspatiH । “amBasA hemaratnAyaH kAMsyaM SuDyeta BasmanA । amlEstAmraYca rEtyaYca punaHpAkena mfRmayam ॥” rAjaDarmme । “pajjalocCizwakAMsyaM yat gavAGrAtamaTApi vA । gaRqUzocCizwamami ca viSuDyeddaSaBistu tat ॥” daSaBirdinEriti SezaH । taTA ca । “kAMsye na DAvayet pAdO yatra syAdapi Bojanamiti .” yatra pAtrAntare BojanaM tatra SrutasyEva tasya sAhacaryyAt kAMsyavacCudDiH ॥ * ॥ bODAyanaH । “BinnakAMsye ta yo'SnIyAt nadyAM snAtvA japeddijaH । gAyattryazwasahasrantu ekaBaktastataH SuciH ॥” devalaH । tAmrarajatasuvarRASmasPawikAnAM BinnamaBinnam । iti Binnatve'pi na doza ityarTaH ॥ * ॥ vizRuH । SArIrErmalEH surABirmadyErvvA yadupahataM tadatyantopahataM sarvvaM lOhaBARqamagnO prataptaM SaDye ta । maRimayamaSmamayamabjamayaYca saptarAtraM mahIKananena SfNgadantAsTimayaYca takzaRena dAru mayaM mfRmayaM jahyAditi । lOhapada suvarRAdyazwakaparam ॥ * ॥ manuH । “trIRidevAH pavitrARi brAhmaRAnAmakalpayan adfzwamadBirnirRiktaM yacca vAcA praSasyate ॥” adfzwamupaGAtaSaNkAdiBirajYAtam । ajYAtaYca sadA Suci iti yAjYavalkyEkavAkyatvAt । vAceti upaGAtaSaNkAyAM pavitraM Bavatviti brAhmaREryadvAcA praSasyate iti SUlapARimahAmahopADyAyakullUkaBawwO ॥ * ॥ SAtAtapaH । “gokule kanduSAlAyAM tElayantrekzuyantrayoH । amImAMsyAni SOcAni strIzu vAlAturezu ca ॥” manuH । “makzikA vipruzaSCAyA gOraSvaH sUryyaraSmayaH । rajo BUrvvAyuragniSca sparSe meDyAni nirdiSet ॥” bODAyanaH । “aduzwAH santatADArA vAtodDUtASca reRavaH । AkarAH SucayaH sarvve varjayitvA surAkaram ॥” SaNKaliKitO । AkaradravyARi prokzitAni SucIni ॥ * ॥ yamaH । “AmamAMsaM GftaM kzOdraM snehASca PalasamBavAH । mlecCaBARqasTitA duzwA nizkrAntAH SucayaH smftAH ॥” vizRuDarmBottare । “muKavarjaYca gOH SudDA mArjjAraScakrame SuciH । puzpARAYca PalAnAYca prokzaRAt SudDirizyate ॥” atriH । “makzikA santatADArA BUmistoyaM hutASanaH । mArjjAraScApi darvvI ca mArutaSca sadA SuciH ॥” bODAyanaH । anekodvAhye dAruSile BUmisame izwakASca saNkIrRIBUtAH iti । saNkIrRIBUtAH parasparasambadDAH ॥ * ॥ vizRuH । prokzaRena pustakaM iti ॥ * ॥ SAtAtapaH । “tApanaM GftatElAnAM plAvanaM gorasasya ca । tanmAtramudDftaM SuDyet kaWinantu payo daDi । avilInaM taTA sarpirvvilInaM SrapaRena tu ॥” avilInaM kaWinam ॥ * ॥ manuH । “dravyARAYcEva sarvvezAM SudDirutplavanaM smftam । prokzaRaM saMhatAnAYca dvAravARAYca takzaRam ॥” idantUcCizwAdyalpadoze । utplavanaM vastrAntaranirvvApaRena kIwAdyapanayanam ॥ * ॥ SAtAtapaH । “klIvABiSaptapatitEH sUtikodakyanAstikEH । dfzwaM vA syAt yadannantu tasya nizkf tirucyate ॥ aByukzya kiYcidudDftya BuYjItApyaviSaNkitaH ॥ * ॥ devalaH । “cARqAlena SunA vApi dfzwaM havirayajYiyam । viqAlAdiBirucCizwaM duzwamannaM vivarjayet ॥” anyatra hiraRyodakasparSAditi ॥ * ॥ manuH । “adBistu prokzaRaM SOcaM bahUnAM DAnyavAsasAm । prakzAlanena tvalpAnAmadBiH SOcaM viDIyate ॥” SudDirityanuvfttO vizRuH । guqAnAmikzuvikArARAM praBUtAnAM vAyvagnidAnena sarvvalavaRAnAYceti ॥ * ॥ aNgirAH । “yaTA yatastato hyApaH SudDiM yAnti nadIM gatAH SUdrAdvipragfhezvannaM pravizwantu sadA Suci ॥” pravizwaM svatvApAdakapratigrAhAdineti SezaH ॥ “sakuRapaM sakarddamaM teByastoyamapAsya tat । prakzipet paYcagavyaYca samantraM sarvvaSu dDikft ॥ apAsya kuRapaM teByo bahutoyeBya eza vA । SataM zazwyaTavA triMSat toyakumBAn samudDaret ॥ paYcanavyaM tatastezu prakzipenmantrapUrvvakam ॥” SatAdi alpatvAdyapekzayA atyalpasya sarvvodDAraRABiDAnAt ॥ * ॥ bfhanmanuH । “SvaSUdrapatitAScAntyA mftASce dvijamandire । SOcaM tatra pravakzyAmi manunA BAzitaM yaTA ॥ daSarAtrAcCuni prete mAsAt SUdre BavecCuciH । dvAByAntu patite gehe antye mAsacatuzwAyAt । anyantye varjayedgehamityevaM manuravravIt ॥” yamaH । “dvijasva maraRe veSma viSuDyati dinatrayAt । dinEkena bahirBumiragnikzepaRalepanEH ॥” * ॥ yaToktakAlAnantaraM karttavyamAha sambarttaH । “gfhaSudDiM pravakzyAmi antaHsTaSavadUzite । protsfjya mfRmayaM pAtraM sidDamannaM taTEva ca ॥ gfhAdapAsya tat sarvvaM gomayenAnulepayet । gomayenAnulipyATa CAgenAGrApayedbuDaH ॥ vrAhmaRErmmantrapUtESca hiraRyakuSavAriBiH । sarvvamaByu kzayedveSma tataH SuDyatyasaMSayaH ॥” mantrAnAdeSe gAyattrI ॥ * ॥ devalaH । “paYcaDA vA caturDA vA BUrameDyA viSuDyati । duzwA dviDA triDA vApi SuDyate malinEkaDA ॥ dahanaM KananaM BUmerupalepanavApane । parjanyavarzaRaYcApi SOcaM paYcaviDaM smftam ॥ prasUte garBiRI yatra mriyate yatra mAnuzaH । cARqAlEruzitaM yatra yatra vinyasyate SavaH ॥ viRmutropahataM yacca kuRapo yatra dfSyate । evaM kaSmalaBUyizWA BUrameDyAtikaTyate ॥ kfmikIwapadakzepardUzitA yatra medinI । trapsayA karzaREH kziptA vAntErvvA duzwatAM vrajet ॥ naKadantatanUjatvaktuzapAMSurajomalEH । BasmapaNkatfRErvvApi pracCannA malinA Bavet ॥” vApanaM mfdantareRa pUraRam । trapsA GanIBUtaSlezmAdi । iti SudDitattvam ॥ * ॥ apica । yAjYavalkya uvAca । “dravyaSudDiM pravakzyAmi tAnniboData sattamAH । sOvarRarAjatAbjAnAM SAkavajrAdicarmmaRAm ॥ pAtrARAM camasAnAYca vAriRA SudDirizyate । uzRavArBiH SrukSruvayorDAnyAdeH prokzaRena ca ॥ takzaRAt dAruSfNgAderyajYapAtrasya mArjanAt । sozRErudakagomUtrEH SuDyatyAvikakESikam ॥ BEkzaM yozinmu KaM puRyaM punaH pAkAnmahImayam । goGrAte ca taTA keSamakzikAkIwadUzite । BasmakzepAdviSudDiH syAdviSudDirmArjanAdinA ॥ trapusIsakatAmrARAM kzArAmlodakavAriBiH । BasmAdBirlohakAMsyAnAmajYAtaYca sadA Suci ॥ ameDyAktasya mfttoyErganDalepApakarzaRAt । Suci gotfptidaM toyaM prakftisTaM mahIgatam ॥ taTA mAMsaM SvacARqAlakravyadAdinipAtitam । raSmiragnI rajaSCAyA gOraSvo vasuDAnilaH ॥ aSvAjavipra zo meDyAstaTA cAmalabindavaH । snAtvA pItvA kzute supte BuktA raTyopasarpaRe ॥ AcAntaH punarAcAmet vAso vyutpariDAyaca । kzute nizWIvite svApe pariDAne'SrupAtane ॥ paYcasvetezu nAcAmet dakziRaM SravaRaM spfSet । tizWantyagnyAdayo devA viprakarRe tu dakziRe ॥” iti gAruqe 97 aDyAyaH ॥ anyacca । “maRivastraprabAlAnAM tadvanmuktAPalasya ca । SEladArumayAnAYca tfRagulmOzaDasya ca ॥ SAkaDAnyAjinAnAYca saMhatAnAYca vAsasAm । valkalAnAmaSezARAmambunA SudDirizyate ॥ sasnehAnAmaTozRena tilakalkena SoDanam । kArpAsikAnAM vastrARAM SudDiH syAt saha BasmanA ॥ nAgadantAsTiSfNgARAM takzaRAcCudDirizyate । punaHpAkena BARqAnAM mfRmayAnAYca SudDatA ॥ SudDaM BakzaM kAruhastaH paRyaM yozinmu kaM taTA । raTyAgatamavijYAtaM dAsavargeRa yat kftam ॥ vAkyaSastaM cirAnItamanekAntaritaM laGu । cezwitaM bAlavfdDAnAM bAlasya tu muKaM Suci ॥ mle cCAnAmapi goSAlAstananDayasutAH striyaH vAgvipruzo dvijendrARAM pAWe vAgambubindavaH ॥ BUmirviSuDyate KAtadAhagokramasecanEH । lepAdulle KanAt sekAt veSmasammArjjanAjjalAt keSakIwAvapanne'nne goGrAte makzikAnvite । mfdvAriBasmakzArARi prakzeptavyAni SudDaye ॥ uqambarARAYcAmlena kzAreRa trapusIsayoH । kAMsyAnAM BasmanA SudDistoyAcCudDirdravasya ca ॥ ameDyAktasya mfttoyErganDApaharaRena ca । anyezAmapi taddravyEH SudDirganDAvahArataH ॥ mAtuH prasavane vatsaH SakuniH PalapAtane । garddaBo BArahAritve SvA mfgagrahaRe SuciH ॥ raTyAkardda matoyAni nAvaH paTi tfRAni ca । mArutenEva SuDyanti pakvezwaracitAni ca ॥ SftaM droRAQakasyAntamameDyABiplu taM Bavet । agramudDftya santyAjyaM Sezasya prokzaRaM smftam ॥ upavAsaM trirAtraM vA dUzitAnnasya Bojane । ajYAte jYAtapUrvve ca nEva SudDirvviDIyate ॥ udakyASvAnanagnAMSca sUtikAntyAvaSAyinaH । spfzwvA snAyIta SOcArTaM taTEva mftahAriRaH ॥ sasne hamasTi saMspfSya savAsAH snAnamAcaret । AcamyEva tu niHsnehaM gAmAlaByArkamIkzya ca ॥” iti vAmanapurARe 14 aDyAyaH ॥ anyat mArkaRqeyapurARe sadAcArADyAye drazwavyam ॥ jalaSudDiryaTA, -- “gaNge ca yamune cEva godAvari sarasvati । narmmade sinDukAveri jale'smin sanniDiM kuru ॥” BUtaSudDistu tacCabde drazwavyA ॥ * ॥ AsanaSudDiryaTA । “ete ganDapuzpe ADAraSaktikamalAsanAya namaH । Asanamantrasya merupfzWa fziH sutalaM CandaH kUrmmo devatA Asanaparigrahe viniyogaH । pfTvi tvayA DftA lokA devi tvaM vizRunA DftA tvaYca DAraya mAM nityaM pavitraM kuru cAsanam ॥” maRqapaSudDiryaTA, -- “paYcagavyena mUlena maRqapaM pariSoDayet ॥” gOtamIye । “SaYcagavyena tadgehaM maRqalaYca viSoDayet ॥” paYcagavyapramARantu tatrEva । “palamAtraM dugDaBAgaM gomUtraM tAvadizyate । GftaYca palamAtraM syAt gomayaM tolakadvayam ॥ daDi prasftimAtraM syAt paYcagavyamidaM smftam । aTavA paYcagavyAnAM samAno BAga izyate ॥ mUlamantreRa saMmantrya tenEva pariSoDayet । tena Water. --Comp. --अंगः a peacock. --कर a. spermatic. --(रः) the marrow of the bones. --भुज् f. a pea-hen. --भूः m. the marrow of the bones. --वरः, --वासरः Friday --शिष्यः a demon.

k.v: सप्तार्चिर्दमुनाः शुक्रश्चित्रभानुर्विभावसुः। शुचिरप्पित्तमौर्वस्तु वाडवो वडवानलः॥
कुबेरः ईशः पतयः पूर्वादीनां दिशां क्रमात्. रविः शुक्रो महीसूनुः स्वर्भानुर्भानुजो विधुः। बुधो बृहस्पतिश्चेति दिशां चैव तथा ग्रहाः। ऐरावतः पुण्डरीको वामनः कुमुदोऽञ्जनः॥
शुक्रो दैत्यगुरुः काव्य उशना भार्गवः कविः। अङ्गारकः कुजो भौमो लोहिताङ्गो महीसुतः॥
वैशाखे माधवो राधो ज्येष्ठे शुक्रः शुचिस्त्वयम्. आषाढे श्रावणे तु स्यान्नभाः श्रावणिकश्च सः॥
शुक्रं तेजोरेतसी च बीजवीर्येन्द्रियाणि च। मायुः पित्तं कफः श्लेष्मा स्त्रियां तु त्वगसृग्धरा॥

GawwAdideyam । mAsula iti BAzA । ityamaraH ॥ GawwaH panTAH tatra AdinA dravyakrayavikrayasTAnAdO ca yaddeyaMdIyate sa Sulko jagAt iti GawI iti rAja iti ca KyAtaH । Salati pratibanDo'neneti SulkaH । Sala ja gatO tAlavyAdiH nAmnItikaH nipAtanAdata utvam । Gawwa cAle Gawwyate'tra iti GaYi GawwaH । Gawwo vartmoti mADavI । Gawwo rAjagrAhyagrahaRasTAnAdiriti mukuwaH । Gawwo GAwa iti KyAte iti ramAnATaH । iti tawwIkAyAM BarataH ॥ (yaTA, manuH । 8 । 307 । “yo'rakzan balimAdatte karaM SulkaYca pArTivaH । pratiBAgaYca daRqaYca sa sadyo narakaM vrajet ॥”) varAdarTagrahaRam iti medinI ॥ (yaTA, manuH । 3 । 51 । “na kanyAyAH pitA vidvAn gfhRIyAt SulkamaRvapi । gfhRan SulkaM hi loBena syAnnaro'patyavikrayI ॥” paRaH । yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 191 । 4 । “ityukto DanurAyamya SulkAvAptaM mahAbalaH । BrAtA BIsena sahitastasTO giririvAcalaH ॥”)

m: शुल्क m. n. (ifc. f आ) price, value, purchase-money, RV.
the prize of a contest, MBh.

nuptial gift (orig. a price given to parents for the purchase of a bride, but in later times bestowed on the wife as her own property together with the profits of household labour, domestic utensils, ornaments &c.), dower, dowry, marriage settlement, Gaut.; Viṣṇ.; Mn. &c. (cf. IW. 267)
wages of prostitution, Kathās.; MārkP.
w.r. for शुक्र and शुक्ल, MBh.
a: शुल्कः, --ल्कं — [शुल्क्यते अतिसृज्यते कर्मणि घञ्] 1 A toll, tax, customs, duty; {{praticularly->particularly||20210104|Dr. Sampada Savardekar and Jim Funderburk|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/20|}} levied at ferries, passes, roads &c.; कः सुधीः संत्यजेद्रांडं शुल्कस्यैवातिसाध्वसात् H. 3. 125; Ms. 8. 159; Y. 2. 47. --2 Gain, profit. --3 Money advanced to ratify a bargain. --4 Purchase-price (of a girl); money given to the parents of a bride; पीडिवो दुंहितृशुल्कसंस्थया R. 11. 38; न कन्याया पिता विद्वान् गृह्णीयाच्छुल्कमण्वपि Ms. 3. 51, 8. 204, 9. 93, 98. --5 A nuptial present. --6 Marriage settlement or dowry. --7 Present given by the bride-groom to his bride. --Comp. --खंडनं defrauding (government) of its due revenue. --ग्राहक, --ग्राहिन् m. a toll-collector. --दः {1} the giver of a nuptial present. {2} an affianced suitor. --शाला --स्थानं a toll-station, {{custo mhouse->customhouse||20210122|Dr. Sampada Savardekar|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/48|}}.

k.v: द्विपाद्यो द्विगुणो दण्डो भागधेयः करो बलिः। घट्टादिदेयं शुल्कोऽस्त्री प्राभृतं तु प्रदेशनम्.।

स्याद्दाम्भिकः कौक्कुटिको यश्चादूरेरितेक्षणः। ललाटिकः प्रभोर्भालदर्शी कार्याक्षमश्च यः॥ भूभृन्नितम्बवलयचक्रेषु कटकोऽस्त्रियाम्. सूच्यग्रे क्षुद्रशत्रौ च रोमहर्षे च कण्टकः। पाकौ पक्तिशिशू मध्यरत्ने नेतरि नायकः। पर्यङ्कः स्यात्परिकरे स्याद्व्याघ्रेऽपि च लुब्धकः। पेटकस्त्रिषु वृन्देऽपि गुरौ देश्ये च देशिकः। खेटकौ ग्रामफलकौ धीवरेऽपिच जालिकः। पुष्परेणौ च किञ्जल्कः शुल्कोऽस्त्री स्त्रीधनेऽपि च। स्यात्कल्लोलेऽप्युत्कलिका वार्धकं भाववृन्दयोः। करिण्यां चापि गणिका दारकौ बालभेदकौ। अन्धेऽप्यनेडमूकः स्याट्टङ्कौ दर्पाश्मदारणौ। मृद्भाण्डेऽप्युष्ट्रिका मन्थे खजको रसदर्वके॥

m: शुल्क—खण्डन n. defrauding the revenue, MW.

शुनः-शेप m. ‘dog-tailed’, N. of a Vedic Ṛṣi (having the patr. Ājīgarti, as son of Ajīgarta or Ajīgarta, and regarded as the author of the hymns, i, 24-30, ix, 3; accord. to AitBr. vii, 13-18, king Hariścandra, whose priest was Viśvā-mitra, being childless, made a vow that on obtaining a son he would sacrifice him to the god Varuṇa; a son was then born to him named Rohita, but Hariścandra put off on various pretexts the fulfilment of his vow, and when he at length consented to perform it, his son refused to be sacrificed, and retiring to the forest passed six years there until he met a poor Brāhman Ṛṣi named Ajīgarta, who had three sons, the second of whom, Śunaḥ-śepa, was purchased by Rohita for a hundred cows to serve as a substitute for himself ; Varuṇa having accepted him as a ransom, he was about to be sacrificed, Viśvā-mitra being Hotṛ priest, when he saved himself by reciting verses in praise of various deities, and was received into the family of Viśvā-mitra as one of his sons under the name of Deva-rāta q.v.: the legend is different in the Rāmāyaṇa, which makes Ambarīṣa, king of Ayodhyā, perform a sacrifice, the victim of which is stolen by Indra; this king is described as wandering over the earth in search of either the real victim or a substitute until he meets with a Brāhman named Ṛcīka, from whom he purchases his middle son, Śunaḥ-śepa, who is about to be sacrificed, when Viśvā-mitra saves him by teaching him a prayer to Agni and two hymns to Indra and Viṣṇu; see R. i, 61, 62), RV. &c. &c. (IW. 25-27)
शुनः-शेप n. the genital organ of a dog, MW.
a: शुनःशेपः(फः) — N. of a Vedic sage, son of Ajīgarta. [In the Aitareya Brāhmaṇa it is related that king Hariścandra, being childless, made a vow that on obtaining a son he would sacrifice him to the god Varuṇa. A son was born who was named Rohita, but the king put off the fulfilment of the vow under various pretexts. At last Rohita purchased for one hundred cows Śunaḥśepha, the middle son of Ajīgarta, as a substitute for himself to be offered to Varuṇa. But the boy praised Viṣṇu, Indra, and other deities, and escaped death. He was then adopted by Viśvāmitra in his own family and called by the name Devarāta].
